Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly concatenate the letters from the 5x7 block. Specifically, when reading the third row "GLIDE" and the fourth row "DPEAC", the Planner incorrectly combined them as "GLIDEPEACE" (skipping the 'D' from the end of "GLIDE" or misaligning the rows), whereas the correct concatenation of "GLIDE" + "DPEAC" is "GLIDEDPEAC". This resulted in the final sentence "THE SEA GULL GLIDE PEACEFULLY..." instead of the correct "THE SEA GULL GLIDED PEACEFULLY...". The error stems from a lack of rigorous verification of the character sequence against the explicit instruction to "use all of the letters in order".
